computedWith: keras.Model(Input((7,7,2048)), predictions(avg_pool(x))) from the loaded ResNet50's own layers; Grad-CAM with tf.GradientTape on the scaled tensor
input: assets/<imageId>/conv5.bin scaled per channel (channels not listed keep scale 1)
gradcamNote: camRaw = sum_c alpha_c * A'[i][j][c] with alpha_c = mean over the grid of d logit_k / d A', before ReLU and normalization. alpha_c = W[c][k] / 49, so camRaw = (1/49) * sum_c W[c][k] * s_c * A[i][j][c].
